pages.title: About us - Element Logic
pages.main_text_excerpt:
About Element Logic
Since 1985, Element Logic® has been optimizing warehouse performance by turning complexity into simplicity and empowering ambitious businesses with a competitive advantage.
As a global leader in intelligent warehouse automation, we merge advanced technology with deep expertise and a people-first mindset. We specialize in intelligent warehouse automation, combining cutting-edge robotics with AI-powered software to optimize operations for businesses worldwide. 
 
Our scalable, flexible solutions maximize efficiency and streamline operations, ensuring that customers always benefit from the latest features and innovations as their needs evolve. 
 
We do not just sell technology, we solve challenges. Our mission is to make your warehouse faster, smarter, and more sustainable. 
By viewing the warehouse as a complete ecosystem, we design purpose-built solutions for your needs.
Our Story
Learn how our journey started, what we stand for, and what drives us.
Career
Element Logic consists of committed and competent employees who value exciting and challenging opportunities.
Locations
Search and find your Element Logic location and contact us today!
Management
See our Executive Management Team.
Events and Exhibitions

pages.title: Career - Element Logic
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Passion creates results
Brave. Passionate. Reliable. Three words that sum up Element Logic’s identity.
As a vibrant, busy, international company with high ambitions, we go the extra mile – not only for our customers, but also for our employees.
In Element Logic culture is one of our valued drivers. Having fun at work true to the motto “One team, one dream” are principles we not only have on paper, but also live by – every day.
Element Logic is represented all over the world. Our history as a Scandinavian company is reflected in our corporate values and organizational structure. Even though technology is part of our everyday lives, our highest asset is in our people. It is not a culture based on hierarchy, but rather focused on creating a respectful, humble, and open environment. We emphasize a healthy work–life balance and actively encourage our employees to spend time being active each day.
GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are extremely proud to get certified by our employees and Great Place to Work.
Great Place to Work is a worldwide employee survey measuring employee satisfaction. Credibility, respect, fairness, pride, and community are the five dimensions that are measured, and that gives important indications on how we succeed as a company taking care of our employees and our culture.
As an Element Logic employee, you will be part of a bustling, international environment with plenty of room for exciting career opportunities. Our Element Academy professional development platform ensures that all Element Logic employees have access to standardized training in our products, processes, and tools.
			
We always think in process and succeed by great teamwork
Sanjin Vujanovic, Key Account Manager Element Logic Denmark

pages.title: Events & Exhibitions - Element Logic
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Want to learn more about optimising your warehouse? Come meet us at one of the events we are attending.
Logistics Market Conference & Expo is a regional logistics event in Belgrade on October 6, 2026, focused on logistics, intralogistics, automation, and transportation. It combines an exhibition, industry presentations, and B2B meetings, targeting companies within manufacturing, retail, 3PL, and logistics.
As a silver sponsor, Element Logic will attend The ARC in Oslo on October 15, 2026 – the leading Nordic conference for warehouse automation and robotics. The event brings together industry experts, exhibitors, and decision-makers to share real-world insights on automation projects, business cases, and the latest intralogistics technologies. We look forward to connecting with peers and exploring the solutions shaping the future of automated warehouses in the Nordic market.
LOGISTICS EXPO is a major trade show in Thessaloniki focused on transport, warehouse automation, intralogistics, and supply chain technology, bringing together logistics professionals from Greece, the Balkans, and Southeast Europe.
PACK EXPO International 2026 is set to be the most expansive, most dynamic packaging and processing show of the year. With attendees from 40+ vertical industries and over 2,600 exhibitors coming together, the possibilities for connection, innovation and sales are endless!
The BVL Supply Chain CX at Estrel Berlin is THE leading event for the supply chain world. The Congress Area is a place for visionaries, top decision-makers, and thought leaders. Seven key topics will be discussed by experts from business and research on strategic questions with the participants. A highlight is the awarding of the German Logistics Award, as well as the subsequent Networking Night.

pages.title: Our Story - Element Logic
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Our Story
Ever since Element Logic saw the light of day in 1985, we have been maximizing the success of warehouses across the globe.
Optimizing since day one
From humble beginnings – timing warehouse workers with stopwatches – we have evolved into a global leader in warehouse automation. Our breakthrough came in 2003 when we implemented the world’s first AutoStore™ system, pioneering a new era in logistics robotics.
Headquartered in Norway, and with a foundation built on curiosity, reliability, and performance, we continue to lead the way. By combining intelligent software, robotics, and a people-first philosophy, we solve the industry’s toughest challenges.
With a constant focus on innovation, we continuously bring new technology and services to the market, designed to fill the gaps in traditional warehousing and optimize performance end-to-end.
What has not changed is our mindset. We remain close to our customers, agile in our approach, and driven to deliver results.
Who We Are and What Drives Us
In Element Logic, we are driven by people, powered by innovation, and connected across the globe.
Our team of over a thousand experts combine decades of warehouse experience with the latest robotics and data-driven software to deliver end-to-end solutions that boost efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. From e-commerce and retail to manufacturing and 3PL, we empower our customers to stay ahead in dynamic markets. 
 
While our technology is advanced, it is our people who truly make the difference and help our customers succeed.
What We Do
We deliver scalable, full-cycle automation solutions – from consulting and design to intelligent software and lifecycle support, all rooted in deep industry insight.
Whether integrated with AutoStore™ or developed beyond it, our solutions are designed to streamline logistics, boost accuracy, and future-proof warehouse operations.
Our offering includes:
- Warehouse design and consulting
- Integrated robotics and automated material handling
- Element Logic Warehouse Software (WCS, AI applications and warehouse analytics
- Automation-as-a-Service and flexible financial solutions
- Lifecycle support and service offering
Shipping and Outbound.
Control Flow. Deliver Precision.
Orders move seamlessly through the material handling systems, ensuring efficient dispatch.
Click for more info
Element Logic Warehouse Software tracks, sorts, and routes orders through integrated systems—giving you full control and visibility to optimize outbound flows.
Real-time Data Insights and Analytics
Smarter Insights. Faster Results.
The Element Logic Warehouse Intelligence System delivers real-time data and predictive analytics with seamless AutoStore/WCS integration—giving you the power to optimize every move.
- Boost Workforce Performance: Identify training needs and increase daily output.
- Maximize Productivity: Eliminate bottlenecks and streamline workflows.
- Optimize Storage: Free up space and keep high-demand items ready.
- Prevent Failures: Detect issues early and minimize downtime.
Picking and Packing.
Pick Smart. Pack Fast.
Speed up order fulfillment with efficient picking and packing.
Element Logic Warehouse Software enables smooth workflows, real-time system updates, and flexible handling for all outbound processes—fully integrated with AutoStore, robotic piece-picking, and material handling solutions.
Storage and Buffering.
Optimize Space. Secure Flow.
Maximize space and keep operations flowing by moving goods to storage systems.
Element Logic Warehouse Software manages storage systems, buffers, and hand-offs to picking stations, ensuring efficiency and adaptability for your unique needs.
Receiving and Inbound.
Start Smooth. Move More.
Streamline stock intake with automated scanning, quality checks, and smart labeling.
Element Logic Warehouse Software directs goods to the right storage area and gives you real-time visibility to track and optimize every step.
Returns and Replenishment.
Simplify Returns. Replenish Stock Fast.
Quality check, repackage, and restock—prioritizing fast-movers for maximum availability.
Element Logic Warehouse Software orchestrates automated systems and robots to streamline every step of returns and replenishment.
With offices across the world, we combine global strength with local expertise. Our teams speak your language, understand your challenges, and deliver tailored solutions with global support.
Mission 
To make our customers more profitable by optimizing their warehouse performance. 
Vision 
To revolutionize warehousing worldwide. 
Our Values 
At Element Logic, our values are more than words – they guide every decision we make, from designing solutions to supporting our people and partners. They are the foundation of how we revolutionize warehousing together. 
We are Brave 
We think differently, challenge the status quo, and lead with bold ideas. 
We learn fast, act with confidence, and push our industry forward.

With a constant focus on innovation, we continuously bring new technology and services to the market, designed to fill the gaps in traditional warehousing and optimize performance end-to-end.
What has not changed is our mindset. We remain close to our customers, agile in our approach, and driven to deliver results.
Who We Are and What Drives Us
In Element Logic, we are driven by people, powered by innovation, and connected across the globe.
Our team of over a thousand experts combine decades of warehouse experience with the latest robotics and data-driven software to deliver end-to-end solutions that boost efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. From e-commerce and retail to manufacturing and 3PL, we empower our customers to stay ahead in dynamic markets. 
 
While our technology is advanced, it is our people who truly make the difference and help our customers succeed.
What We Do
We deliver scalable, full-cycle automation solutions – from consulting and design to intelligent software and lifecycle support, all rooted in deep industry insight.
Whether integrated with AutoStore™ or developed beyond it, our solutions are designed to streamline logistics, boost accuracy, and future-proof warehouse operations.
Our offering includes:
- Warehouse design and consulting
- Integrated robotics and automated material handling
- Element Logic Warehouse Software (WCS, AI applications and warehouse analytics
- Automation-as-a-Service and flexible financial solutions
- Lifecycle support and service offering

Real-time Data Insights and Analytics
Smarter Insights. Faster Results.

- Boost Workforce Performance: Identify training needs and increase daily output.
- Maximize Productivity: Eliminate bottlenecks and streamline workflows.
- Optimize Storage: Free up space and keep high-demand items ready.

Picking and Packing.
Pick Smart. Pack Fast.
Speed up order fulfillment with efficient picking and packing.
Element Logic Warehouse Software enables smooth workflows, real-time system updates, and flexible handling for all outbound processes—fully integrated with AutoStore, robotic piece-picking, and material handling solutions.
Storage and Buffering.
Optimize Space. Secure Flow.
Maximize space and keep operations flowing by moving goods to storage systems.
Element Logic Warehouse Software manages storage systems, buffers, and hand-offs to picking stations, ensuring efficiency and adaptability for your unique needs.
Receiving and Inbound.
Start Smooth. Move More.
Streamline stock intake with automated scanning, quality checks, and smart labeling.
Element Logic Warehouse Software directs goods to the right storage area and gives you real-time visibility to track and optimize every step.
Returns and Replenishment.
Simplify Returns. Replenish Stock Fast.
Quality check, repackage, and restock—prioritizing fast-movers for maximum availability.
Element Logic Warehouse Software orchestrates automated systems and robots to streamline every step of returns and replenishment.
